mapper.select: /** generalcustomer-mapper.getGeneralCustomerCountByParam (일반회원관리 목록 총 갯수 조회) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OP_USER U INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL UD ON UD.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UD.USE_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE U.STATUS_CODE = 9

/** generalcustomer-mapper.getGeneralCustomerDetails (일반회원관리 상세 조회) */ SELECT A.user_id, crypto_dec('normal', A.login_id, '', 0) AS login_id, crypto_dec('normal', A.user_name, '', 0) AS user_name, crypto_dec('normal', A.email, '', 0) AS email, A.sbscrb_se_code, A.user_key, A.status_code, A.sbscrb_se_nm, A.created_date, A.login_date, crypto_dec('normal', A.post, '', 0) AS post, crypto_dec('normal', A.address, '', 0) AS address, crypto_dec('normal', A.address_detail, '', 0) AS address_detail, A.receive_email, A.receive_sms, crypto_dec('normal', A.phone_number, '', 0) AS phone_number, crypto_dec('normal', A.gender, '', 0) AS gender, crypto_dec('normal', A.birthday, '', 0) AS birthday, A.total_cntr_amt, A.total_cntr_blce_point FROM ( SELECT U.user_id, U.login_id, U.user_name, U.email, U.sbscrb_se_code, U.user_key, U.status_code, C.label AS sbscrb_se_nm, CASE WHEN IFNULL(U.created_date, '') != '' THEN DATE_FORMAT(U.created_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE '' END AS created_date, CASE WHEN IFNULL(U.login_date, '') != '' THEN DATE_FORMAT(U.login_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') ELSE '' END AS login_date, UD.post, UD.address, UD.address_detail, UD.receive_email, UD.receive_sms, UD.phone_number, UD.gender, UD.birthday, (SELECT SUM(cntr_amt) FROM G_CNTR WHERE user_id = U.user_id AND sttemnt_pay_de IS NOT NULL AND delete_at = 'N' AND cntr_sttus_code = '200') AS total_cntr_amt, (SELECT SUM(cntr_blce_point) FROM G_CNTR WHERE user_id = U.user_id AND sttemnt_pay_de IS NOT NULL AND delete_at = 'N' AND cntr_sttus_code = '200') AS total_cntr_blce_point FROM OP_USER U INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL UD ON UD.user_id = U.user_id AND UD.use_flag = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C ON C.code_type = 'SBSCRB_SE' AND C.use_yn = 'Y' AND C.language = 'ko' AND C.id = U.sbscrb_se_code WHERE U.status_code = 9 AND U.user_id = #{userId} ) A

/** generalcustomer-mapper.getGeneralCustomerCumulativeTotal (기부, 포인트 누적합계 정보 조회) */ SELECT TOTAL_CNTR_AMT , TOTAL_CNTR_POINT , TOTAL_CNTR_USE_POINT , (TOTAL_CNTR_POINT - TOTAL_CNTR_USE_POINT) AS TOTAL_CNTR_BLCE_POINT FROM ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_AMT),0) AS TOTAL_CNTR_AMT, IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_POINT), 0) AS TOTAL_CNTR_POINT, SUM(CNTR_BLCE_POINT) AS TOTAL_CNTR_BLCE_POINT, ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(A.CNTR_USE_POINT), 0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT A LEFT OUTER JOIN G_CNTR B ON A.CNTR_SN = B.CNTR_SN AND B.DELETE_AT = 'N' WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.USE_SE_CODE = '1' ) AS TOTAL_CNTR_USE_POINT FROM G_CNTR WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND DELETE_AT = 'N' AND CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' ) A

/** generalcustomer-mapper.getGeneralCustomerCntrCountByParam (기부내역 목록 갯수 조회) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM G_CNTR CN INNER JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON L.LOCGOV_CODE = CN.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE WHERE CN.USER_ID = #{userId} AND CN.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND CN.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND CN.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200'

/** generalcustomer-mapper.getGeneralCustomerCntrListByParam (기부내역 목록 조회) */
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CN.CNTR_DE,'%Y-%m-%d') AS CNTR_DE, CN.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, L.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE AS CNTR_UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE, L.LOCGOV_NM AS CNTR_LOCGOV_NM, L.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM AS CNTR_UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, CN.CNTR_AMT, CN.CNTR_POINT, DATE_FORMAT(CN.STTEMNT_PAY_DE,'%Y-%m-%d') AS STTEMNT_PAY_DE, CN.ELCTRN_PAY_NO, CN.CNTR_PATH_CODE, C.LABEL AS CNTR_PATH_NM FROM G_CNTR CN INNER JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON L.LOCGOV_CODE = CN.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C ON C.CODE_TYPE = 'CNTR_PATH' AND C.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.ID = CN.CNTR_PATH_CODE WHERE CN.USER_ID = #{userId} AND CN.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND CN.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND CN.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' ORDER BY CN.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC

/** generalcustomer-mapper.getGeneralCustomerPointListByParam (포인트 내역 목록 조회) */
SELECT POINT_TYPE, DATE_FORMAT(A.CNTR_DE,'%Y-%m-%d') AS CNTR_DE, L.LOCGOV_CODE AS CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, L.LOCGOV_NM AS CNTR_LOCGOV_NM, L.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE AS CNTR_UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE, L.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM AS CNTR_UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, A.CNTR_AMT, A.CNTR_POINT, A.CNTR_USE_POINT, (A.CURRENT_CNTR_POINT - A.CURRENT_CNTR_USE_POINT) AS CNTR_BLCE_POINT, A.ORDER_CODE FROM ( SELECT 'OCC' AS POINT_TYPE, CNTR_DE, CNTR_AMT, CNTR_POINT, CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, '' AS ORDER_CODE, '' AS CNTR_USE_POINT, ( SELECT SUM(CNTR_POINT) FROM G_CNTR A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID AND A.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND A.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND A.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' ) AS CURRENT_CNTR_POINT, ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_USE_POINT),0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID ) AS CURRENT_CNTR_USE_POINT, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '' AS USE_SN FROM G_CNTR GC WHERE GC.USER_ID = #{userId} AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'USE' AS POINT_TYPE, POINT_USE_DE AS CNTR_DE, '' AS CNTR_AMT, '' AS CNTR_POINT, CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, ORDER_CODE, CNTR_USE_POINT, ( SELECT SUM(CNTR_POINT) FROM G_CNTR A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID AND A.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND A.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND A.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' ) AS CURRENT_CNTR_POINT, ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_USE_POINT),0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID ) AS CURRENT_CNTR_USE_POINT, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, USE_SN FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT GC WHERE GC.USER_ID = #{userId} ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON L.LOCGOV_CODE = A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE ORDER BY A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC, USE_SN DESC
mapper.update: /** generalcustomer-mapper.updateSecedeGeneralCustomer (회원 탈퇴) */ UPDATE OP_USER SET PASSWORD = NULL, USER_NAME = NULL, EMAIL = NULL, STATUS_CODE = 3, LOGIN_COUNT = NULL, SLEEP_MAIL_SEND_DATE = NULL, LOGIN_DATE = NULL, DENY_DATE = NULL, LEAVE_DATE = , LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT = 0, LOGIN_TRY_DATE = NULL, PASSWORD_TYPE = 'N', PASSWORD_EXPIRED_DATE = NULL, UPDATED_DATE = NULL, CREATED_DATE = NULL, LOCGOV_CODE = NULL, MBER_CI = NULL, MBER_DI = NULL, MBER_DN = NULL, SBSCRB_SE_CODE = NULL, LOGIN_PATH_CODE = NULL, USER_KEY = NULL WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

/** generalcustomer-mapper.updateSecedeGeneralCustomerDetail (회원 상세 탈퇴) */ UPDATE OP_USER_DETAIL SET GROUP_CODE = NULL, LEVEL_ID = 0, USER_LEVEL_EXPIRATION_DATE = NULL, NEW_POST = NULL, POST = NULL, ADDRESS = NULL, ADDRESS_DETAIL = NULL, TEL_NUMBER = NULL, PHONE_NUMBER = NULL, FAX_NUMBER = NULL, RECEIVE_EMAIL = NULL, RECEIVE_SMS = NULL, RECEIVE_PUSH = NULL, GENDER = NULL, AGE = NULL, POINT = NULL, BUY_COUNT = NULL, BUY_PRICE = NULL, LAST_BUY_DATE = NULL, LEAVE_REASON = #{leaveReason}, SITE_FLAG = NULL, USE_FLAG = 'N', BIRTHDAY_TYPE = NULL, BIRTHDAY = NULL, LEAVE_CODE = #{leaveCode}, LEAVE_USER_ID = #{leaveUserId} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: /** generalcustomer-mapper.getGeneralCustomerDetailsNotStatusCode (일반회원관리 상세 조회 - 상태코드 미적용) */ SELECT A.user_id, crypto_dec('normal', A.login_id, '', 0) AS login_id, crypto_dec('normal', A.user_name, '', 0) AS user_name, crypto_dec('normal', A.email, '', 0) AS email, A.sbscrb_se_code, A.user_key, A.status_code, A.mber_ci, A.sbscrb_se_nm, A.created_date, A.login_date, crypto_dec('normal', A.post, '', 0) AS post, crypto_dec('normal', A.address, '', 0) AS address, crypto_dec('normal', A.address_detail, '', 0) AS address_detail, A.receive_email, crypto_dec('normal', A.phone_number, '', 0) AS phone_number, crypto_dec('normal', A.gender, '', 0) AS gender, crypto_dec('normal', A.birthday, '', 0) AS birthday, A.total_cntr_amt, A.total_cntr_blce_point FROM ( SELECT U.user_id, U.login_id, U.user_name, U.email, U.sbscrb_se_code, U.user_key, U.status_code, U.mber_ci, C.label AS sbscrb_se_nm, CASE WHEN IFNULL(U.created_date, '') != '' THEN DATE_FORMAT(U.created_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE '' END AS created_date, CASE WHEN IFNULL(U.login_date, '') != '' THEN DATE_FORMAT(U.login_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') ELSE '' END AS login_date, UD.post, UD.address, UD.address_detail, UD.receive_email, UD.phone_number, UD.gender, UD.birthday, (SELECT SUM(cntr_amt) FROM G_CNTR WHERE user_id = U.user_id AND sttemnt_pay_de IS NOT NULL AND delete_at = 'N' AND cntr_sttus_code = '200') AS total_cntr_amt, (SELECT SUM(cntr_blce_point) FROM G_CNTR WHERE user_id = U.user_id AND sttemnt_pay_de IS NOT NULL AND delete_at = 'N' AND cntr_sttus_code = '200') AS total_cntr_blce_point FROM OP_USER U INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL UD ON UD.user_id = U.user_id AND UD.use_flag = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C ON C.code_type = 'SBSCRB_SE' AND C.use_yn = 'Y' AND C.language = 'ko' AND C.id = U.SBSCRB_SE_CODE WHERE U.user_id = #{userId} ) A

/** generalcustomer-mapper.getCntrBlcePointList (잔여 포인트 조회) */ SELECT CNTR_SN, CNTR_POINT - (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_USE_POINT),0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT A WHERE A.CNTR_SN = GC.CNTR_SN) AS CNTR_BLCE_POINT, USER_ID, PSITN_LOCGOV_CODE, CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE FROM G_CNTR GC WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IFNULL(CNTR_BLCE_POINT, 0) > 0 AND STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND DELETE_AT = 'N' AND CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200'

)

mapper.select: /** generalcustomer-mapper.userDeliveryList (배송지 목록) */ SELECT A.user_delivery_id ,A.user_id ,A.default_flag ,A.title ,crypto_dec('normal', A.user_name , '', 0) AS user_name ,crypto_dec('normal', A.mobile , '', 0) AS mobile ,crypto_dec('normal', A.phone , '', 0) AS phone ,crypto_dec('normal', A.address , '', 0) AS address ,crypto_dec('normal', A.address_detail , '', 0) AS address_detail FROM ( SELECT user_delivery_id ,user_id ,default_flag ,title ,user_name ,mobile ,phone ,address ,address_detail FROM OP_USER_DELIVERY WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) A ORDER BY A.default_flag DESC, A.user_delivery_id DESC
